versions.text: Criterion: Verify that autorotation characteristics are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within the following ADS-33-PRF paragraphs: a. 3.4.5.1.3 Pitch control in autorotation. b. 3.7.2 Engine failures. c. 3.7.3 Loss of engine and/or electrical power. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation. Additional References: 14 CFR 27.143 Controllability and maneuverability 14 CFR 29.143 Controllability and maneuverability
